reflect on the past: At the end of each year, I like to reflect on the past and think about what I could do better.
每年年底，我喜歡反思過去，想想自己可以做得更好的地方。
reflect public opinion: The results of the online survey seem to reflect public opinion about the new tax on sugary drinks.
網路調查的結果似乎反映了民意對含糖飲料新稅的看法。
reflect badly on: The students' rude behavior on the field trip will reflect badly on the whole school.
學生在校外教學時的無禮行為會有損整個學校的形象。
reflect light: Snow can reflect light so strongly that skiers often wear dark glasses to protect their eyes.
雪會強烈反射光，所以滑雪者常戴墨鏡保護眼睛。
reflect the change: The new prices on the menu reflect the change in the cost of rice and vegetables this year.
菜單上的新價格反映了今年米和蔬菜成本的變化。
reflect credit on: Winning the national science contest will reflect credit on both the students and their teachers.
贏得全國科學競賽將為學生和他們的老師增光。
reform the system: Instead of throwing it away completely, the government wants to reform the system so it works better.
政府不想完全廢除它，而是想改革制度，讓它運作得更好。
reform a criminal: Many people believe that education and job training are the best ways to reform a criminal.
許多人認為教育和職業訓練是使罪犯改過的最好方法。
reform education: The minister promised to reform education by reducing tests and giving students more time for hobbies.
部長承諾要進行教育改革，減少考試並給學生更多時間發展興趣。
a reformed character: After years in prison, he is now a reformed character who volunteers to keep young people out of trouble.
在牢裡待了好幾年後，他如今是個改過自新的人，當志工幫助年輕人遠離麻煩。
refresh one's memory: Could you show me the photos again to refresh my memory of what happened on that trip?
你能再給我看一次照片，喚起我對那趟旅行經過的記憶嗎？
refresh the page: If the website is not showing the latest scores, try to refresh the page by pressing F5.
如果網站沒有顯示最新比分，試著按F5重新整理頁面。
feel refreshed: After a cool shower and a short nap, I always feel refreshed and ready to study again.
沖個涼、小睡一下後，我總是覺得神清氣爽，準備好再讀書。
refresh one's skills: Before going back to work, the nurse took a short course to refresh her skills in first aid.
回去工作之前，那位護理師上了短期課程溫習急救技能。
a refreshing change: After two weeks of heavy rain, the sunny weekend was a refreshing change for everyone in town.
連下兩週大雨後，晴朗的週末對鎮上每個人來說都是令人耳目一新的改變。
refund the money: The shop agreed to refund the money because my new shoes broke after only one day.
因為我的新鞋只穿一天就壞了，店家同意退款。
be refunded in full: Because the concert was canceled, all ticket holders will be refunded in full within two weeks.
因為演唱會取消，所有持票人將在兩週內全額退費。
demand a refund: The angry customer decided to demand a refund after finding a hair in his soup.
那位生氣的顧客在湯裡發現頭髮後，決定要求退款。
regard as a friend: Deep in my heart, I still regard him as a friend, even though we have not spoken for years.
在我心裡，我仍把他視為朋友，雖然我們已好幾年沒說話了。
highly regarded: Dr. Lin is highly regarded by her patients because she always listens carefully and explains things clearly.
林醫師備受病人推崇，因為她總是仔細傾聽並清楚說明。
regard with suspicion: The villagers tend to regard strangers with suspicion, so newcomers often feel unwelcome at first.
村民往往以懷疑眼光看待陌生人，所以新來的人起初常覺得不受歡迎。
in this regard: Our school wants students to read more, and in this regard, the new library has been a great help.
我們學校希望學生多閱讀，就此而言，新圖書館幫了很大的忙。
with regard to: With regard to your question about the homework, I will explain it again after class.
關於你問的作業問題，我下課後會再解釋一次。
register a complaint: If the hotel room is dirty, you have the right to register a complaint with the manager.
如果飯店房間很髒，你有權向經理提出申訴。
register for a course: Students who want to register for a course in Japanese must sign up online before Friday.
想報名日文課程的學生必須在週五前上網登記。
register surprise: Her face did not register surprise at all when she heard the news, as if she had already known.
她聽到消息時臉上絲毫沒有流露驚訝，好像她早就知道了。
register a company: To open his own coffee shop legally, he first had to register a company with the city government.
為了合法開自己的咖啡店，他得先向市政府登記公司。
the news didn't register: I was so tired that the news didn't register until my sister repeated it the next morning.
我太累了，消息沒聽進去，直到隔天早上姊姊又說了一遍。
register to vote: Young people who turn eighteen this year should register to vote before the election in December.
今年滿十八歲的年輕人應該在十二月選舉前登記投票。
